facility.name: Xplor
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 8350 PARKWOOD HILL BLVD, FORT WORTH, TX, 76137

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Redirecting Behavior: Discipline and guidance methods were not used to encourage self-control or self-direction.  Behavior was not verbally redirected, instead, the caregiver held the child in a manner where his movements were restricted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Redirecting Behavior (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(C))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: The child was grabbed, picked up off the floor, and then held for approximately 3 minutes where he could not move after the child refused to pick up toys when requested.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The loose fill surrounding the structure was not at 6 inches deep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The fence on the playground is bent with wire sticking out.     A walk through of the operation was not conducted and still water was pooling in the playground grounds.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: A caregiver grabbed and yanked a child's shoulders and arms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: A caregiver did not report an inappropriate behavior incident to a parent that took place between children while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training: A caregiver withheld milk from a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training (26 TAC §746.2805(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: A caregiver did not intervene when a child was being physical active in the classroom and became injured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One children's files did not have the current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Record Storage - Training Records: Health and saefty training records were missing from personnel files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Record Storage - Training Records (26 TAC §746.907(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation. A caregiver did not allow a child to go to the restroom.  This caused the child to soil on themself and made the child clean up the urine.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training (26 TAC §746.2805(2))

occurrences.finding: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation. A caregiver pinned a child to a cot and aggressively placed children on cots during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §746.2905(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation. Caregivers were seen grabbing children by their arms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employees Supervised: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation. The director did not provide the appropriate supervision of staff that caused caregivers to perform responsibilities inappropriately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Supervised (26 TAC §746.1003(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation. Caregivers were seen yelling at children while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation. The operation did not report to a parent that a child had a busted lip at pick up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation. The director did not report allegations and incidents that occurred at the center which involved children?s safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation. Caregivers did not show or provide courtesy and patience when handling children aggressively.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children (26 TAC §746.1201(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation. Caregivers did not make proper judgement due to not reporting and witnessing mistreatment of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Janitorial duties: A caregiver performed laundry duties while children were in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Janitorial duties (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(C))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Physical Activity including Supervised Tummy Time and Safe, Clean, Uncluttered Area: Caregiver left an infant unattended during tummy time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Physical Activity including Supervised Tummy Time and Safe, Clean, Uncluttered Area (26 TAC §746.2417(3))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation did not report the number of employees who left in 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Feeding schedules have not been updated every 30 days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: One personnel file did not have a signed affidavit.  The affidavit was signed at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: A child's record did not have a signed, completed emergency medical authorization portion of the enrollment application.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Parent did not sign the incident report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not demonstrate competence when accounting for children during transitions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was determined that a child was left unsupervised in a classroom for an unspecified amount of time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Employees Discipline Own Children: It was determined that an employee disciplined their own child using prohibited punishment while the child was in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employees Discipline Own Children (26 TAC §746.2807)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined that a caregiver did not provide good judgement after they allowed a door to remain open resulting in a child leaving the class unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was determined that caregivers did not provide adequate supervision for a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: At time of inspection, a caregiver's first aid training expired on 3/4/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: At time of inspection, there was a deep hole in the outdoor play area. The hole is a tripping hazard. Photos were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: At time of inspection, a caregiver's CPR training expired on 3/4/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child in care with a known food allergy and epi pen did not have a written food allergy emergency plan on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
